entries.definition: having great physical power
lasting a long time without damage
firm to the touch, or difficult
easily broken or damaged

normalIntro.en: These memories use the common collocations with time and decision, the verb pattern with out, and the comparison with though, a common spelling trap.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条利用 time、decision 等常见搭配、与 out 搭配的动词用法，以及与 though 的拼写对照。

normal.en: Tough rhymes with rough and enough, not with though.
normal.cn: tough 与 rough、enough 押韵，不与 though 同韵。

normal.en: A tough decision is hard, not strong; the context tells you which sense is meant.
normal.cn: a tough decision 指难，而非结实，语境决定义项。

normal.en: Tough it out means to endure until the end, and out signals the full stretch.
normal.cn: tough it out 指撑到最后，out 表示贯穿到底。

normal.en: Toughen adds -en to make a verb, as in toughen the rules.
normal.cn: toughen 加 -en 构成动词，如 toughen the rules。

normal.en: A tough act to follow means a hard standard to match, not a violent one.
normal.cn: a tough act to follow 指难以企及的标准，不是凶暴。

abstract.en: Picture a strap drawn tight, its surface lined but whole.
abstract.cn: 想象一条拉紧的皮带，表面起纹却完好无损。

abstract.en: Think of a year with nothing easy in it, walked through one day at a time.
abstract.cn: 想那一年没有一件容易事，却一天天走了过来。

abstract.en: What does not break under force becomes the word for what does not give up.
abstract.cn: 受力不断的东西，最终成了「不放弃」的那个词。

examples.en: These boots are tough enough for a week in the hills.
examples.cn: 这双靴子结实得够在山里走一星期。

examples.en: Leaving the job was a tough decision to make.
examples.cn: 辞掉这份工作是个艰难的决定。

examples.en: The government is getting tough on false advertising.
examples.cn: 政府在虚假广告问题上正变得强硬。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「塔夫」——塔夫绸又厚又耐磨，正像 tough 的坚韧。

root: 古英语 toh（坚韧），与古诺斯语 tog（绳、拉扯）同源。由「抗拉不断」引申出「难嚼、艰难、强硬、凶悍」，形容词又用作名词指硬汉。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts from a material that will not break, then follows the same resistance into food, into hard times and hard tasks, into firm policy and rough manners, and finally into the noun and the casual verb.
sensesIntro.cn: 条目从不会断裂的材料写起，再沿同一份「抵住」的力量走入食物、艰难的日子与难办的事，再进入强硬政策与凶悍作风，最后是名词与口语动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something that will not give way.
core.cn: 核心意象：不肯屈服之物。

branches.en: Material strength and food that resists the teeth.
branches.cn: 材料之强与抗齿之韧。

branches.en: Hard times and hard tasks.
branches.cn: 艰难时期与难办的事。

branches.en: Firm policy and rough surroundings.
branches.cn: 强硬的政策与凶悍的环境。

branches.en: The rough person named by the adjective.
branches.cn: 由形容词命名的凶悍之人。

branches.en: Enduring to the end.
branches.cn: 坚持到底。

intro.en: The word is a short inherited adjective whose family grows with -ness, -ly, -en, and -ie.
intro.cn: 本词是简短的继承形容词，其词族靠 -ness、-ly、-en 与 -ie 扩展。

latinIntro.en: This is a native word with no Latin ancestor, so the Latin entries give related words for strength.
latinIntro.cn: 本词是本土词，没有拉丁语祖先，故拉丁词条列出与强韧相关的词。

items.example: The stem is unchanged in spelling since Middle English.
items.exampleCN: 拼写自中古英语以来未变。

items.example: Toh is the earliest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: toh 是现存最早的记录形式。

items.example: The stem links strength with pulling.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干把强韧与拉扯连在一起。

items.example: Toughness is the quality itself.
Toughly means in a firm way.
Toughen means to make tough.

items.meaning: a person or thing of a kind
items.example: A toughie is a hard problem.
Tougher is the comparative form.
Toughest is the superlative form.

definition_zh: 旅行；参观；巡回演出；任职期；游览；巡回
definition_en: a journey in which several places are visited, or a period of duty in one place, or to travel around an area
core_image: 一辆大巴绕过广场，游客的目光顺着窗外的环形路线转了一圈
scene: 天刚亮，旅店门口就停下一辆白色大巴，导游举着小旗。We took a guided tour of the old town and finished at the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 tour 是名词「游览、参观」（第 2 个义项：由导游带领的短程参观）；句意为我们跟着导游游览了老城，最后在港口结束。画面里有清晨的大巴、小旗与老城的石街。

pos.zh: 名词：旅行；游览；巡回演出；任期
动词：旅行；巡回（演出、访问）

derivatives.zh: 加 -ism 构成，义为「旅游业」
加 -ist 构成，义为「旅游者；游客」
加 -ing 构成，义为「巡回的；用于旅行的」
加前缀 de- 构成，义为「绕道；弯路」

senses.title: A journey through places
senses.definition: a journey visiting several places one after another
senses.definitionCN: 依次造访若干地方的旅行
senses.example: The band spent two years on a world tour.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队花了两年时间做世界巡演。
senses.why: The Latin and French word for a turn gives the idea of going round a set of places and returning.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语与法语中表示「转」的词带来了绕行一圈再回来的概念。

senses.title: A short visit with a guide
senses.definition: a short organised visit to a place, often with a guide
senses.definitionCN: 由人带领下对某处的短程参观
senses.example: The guided tour lasts about an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 这次有导游的参观大约一小时。
senses.why: A short circuit of a building or a town is a mini version of a long journey, so the same word serves.
senses.whyCN: 绕建筑或城镇走一圈是长途旅行的缩小版，于是同一个词也就够用了。

senses.title: A series of performances
senses.definition: a series of public performances or appearances in different places
senses.definitionCN: 在不同地点连续进行的演出或露面
senses.example: The play goes on tour in the autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 这部戏秋天开始巡回上演。
senses.why: Performers who travel from town to town follow a circuit, which is exactly a tour.
senses.whyCN: 艺人逐城而行正是走一条环线，那恰好就是 tour。

senses.title: A period of duty abroad
senses.definition: a fixed period of service in one place, especially abroad or in the army
senses.definitionCN: 在某地（尤指海外或军中）的一段固定服役期
senses.example: He completed a two-year tour in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 他在北方完成了两年任期。
senses.why: A period assigned in one post resembles a round of duty that ends and returns, and soldiers borrowed the word for it.
senses.whyCN: 派在一处的一段时期像一趟有始有终的差事，军人便借用了这个词。

senses.title: To travel around
senses.definition: to travel through an area or a country, visiting several places
senses.definitionCN: 在某一地区或国家往来游览多处
senses.example: They toured the coast by train last summer.
senses.exampleCN: 去年夏天他们坐火车游了沿海一带。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb of going round, with the same image of a circle of visits.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为表示绕行的动词，仍是同一圈造访的意象。

senses.title: To take a visitor round
senses.definition: to show a person or a group round a place
senses.definitionCN: 带某人或某团体参观某处
senses.example: An old student toured us round the laboratories.
senses.exampleCN: 一位老学生带我们参观了实验室。
senses.why: Showing someone round is performing a tour for them, so the verb takes a person or a place as its object.
senses.whyCN: 带人参观就是替人做一趟 tour，故动词可接人或地方作宾语。

senses.title: On the road with a show
senses.definition: to go from place to place giving performances or making appearances
senses.definitionCN: 四处奔走演出或露面
senses.example: The singer toured Europe with a small band.
senses.exampleCN: 那位歌手带着一支小乐队巡演欧洲。
senses.why: This use fixes the word in the entertainment world, where the circuit of cities is a regular route.
senses.whyCN: 这一用法把词固定在演艺界，那里城市之间连成固定线路。

senses.title: A turn in older usage
senses.definition: in older texts, a turn or a circular movement
senses.definitionCN: 较早文本中表示一转或环形运动
senses.example: The old clock's tour of the dial took a full day.
senses.exampleCN: 那座旧钟的指针绕表盘一周要一整天。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply a turn, and every later sense is a journey that comes back to its start.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「一转」，后来所有义项都是回到起点的行程。

intro.en: Tour goes back to Latin tornare, to turn on a lathe, and through Old French tour, a turn, to the modern sense of a circular journey.
intro.cn: tour 可上溯到拉丁语 tornare（在车床上转），经古法语 tour（一转）而到现代表示环行旅程的意思。

items.en: Tornare means to turn or to make round, and tornus names a lathe.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tornare 意为转动、使成圆形，tornus 指车床。

items.en: Tornus itself comes from Greek tornos, a tool for drawing circles.
items.cn: tornus 本身来自希腊语 tornos，一种画圆的工具。

items.en: Old French tour means a turn, a circuit, or a round of duty.
items.cn: 古法语 tour 意为回转、一圈或一轮差事。

items.en: Middle English borrows tour for a journey that goes round and returns.
items.cn: 中古英语借入 tour，指绕行一圈再回来的行程。

items.en: The performing tour appears in the eighteenth century as companies travel between towns.
items.cn: 巡回演出之义于十八世纪出现，因为剧团在城镇间往来。

items.en: Tourism and tourist are coined in the early nineteenth century from the same stem.
items.cn: tourism 与 tourist 于十九世纪初由同一词干造出。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the same stem, while the near-meaning group gathers words for journeys and visits.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一词干上的词，近义组则汇集表示旅行与参观的词。

entries.definition: a person travelling for pleasure
the business of holidays and travel
a longer way round
a tall narrow building
entries.definitionCN: 塔，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: an act of travelling from one place to another
a short visit to a place and back
a short group journey for pleasure
a long journey by sea or in space

normalIntro.en: These memories use the fixed phrases on tour and a tour of, the compounds with guide and package, and the way the word marks a circle.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条利用 on tour 与 a tour of 的固定搭配、与 guide、package 构成的复合词，以及这个词的「一圈」意味。

normal.en: On tour describes a performer or a team, while on a tour describes a traveller.
normal.cn: on tour 指艺人或球队，on a tour 指旅行者。

normal.en: Tour guide and tour operator both put tour before the noun it describes.
normal.cn: tour guide 与 tour operator 都把 tour 放在所修饰名词之前。

normal.en: A package tour bundles travel, hotel, and food into one price.
normal.cn: a package tour 把交通、住宿与餐食打包成一个价钱。

normal.en: Tourist and tourism add -ist and -ism to the same stem.
normal.cn: tourist 与 tourism 是同一词干加 -ist 与 -ism。

normal.en: Detour takes the prefix de- and means a turn away from the direct road.
normal.cn: detour 加前缀 de-，意为偏离直路的绕行。

abstract.en: Picture a bus circling a square and coming back to the same corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆大巴绕广场一圈，又回到同一个街角。

abstract.en: Think of a clock hand sweeping the whole dial and ending where it began.
abstract.cn: 想钟表的指针扫过整个表盘，最后回到起点。

abstract.en: A tour is a turn made large: the same returning shape, drawn across places instead of minutes.
abstract.cn: 旅行是放大的「一转」：同样的回环之形，只是画在地点上而非时间上。

examples.en: The orchestra is on tour in Asia for six weeks.
examples.cn: 乐团正在亚洲巡演六周。

examples.en: She gave us a tour of the new library.
examples.cn: 她带我们参观了新图书馆。

examples.en: We toured the island by bicycle in four days.
examples.cn: 我们用四天骑自行车环游了这座岛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「图」——出门前先摊开一张地图，画个圈就是 tour。

root: 拉丁语 tornare（转）→ 拉丁语 tornus（车床）→ 古法语 tour（一转、一圈）→ 英语 tour。同族词有 tourist、tourism、detour；拉丁 tornare 亦生出 turn 与之同源。

sensesIntro.en: The entry begins with the journey round several places, then reduces it to a short guided visit, widens it to a series of performances and to a term of duty, and closes with the verb and the old sense of a single turn.
sensesIntro.cn: 条目从周游数地的旅程写起，再缩小为有导游的短程参观，扩大到巡回演出与海外任期，最后收在动词用法与「一转」这一古老义项上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a circle of visits that returns to the start.
core.cn: 核心意象：绕行一圈又回到原处的造访。

branches.en: The long journey and the old sense of a turn.
branches.cn: 长途旅行与古老的「一转」义。

branches.en: A short guided visit and the act of showing round.
branches.cn: 短程参观与带人参观的动作。

branches.en: Concerts on the road and touring with a show.
branches.cn: 巡回演出与随团巡演。

branches.en: A fixed period of service abroad.
branches.cn: 海外的一段固定任期。

branches.en: Travelling around an area.
branches.cn: 在一地区内往来游览。

intro.en: The word is a short borrowed stem; its family comes from -ist, -ism, -ing, and the prefix de-.
intro.cn: 本词是简短的借入词干，其词族来自 -ist、-ism、-ing 与前缀 de-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries give the root of turning and the words built on it.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁词条给出「转」的词根及其构成的词。

items.example: The English form drops the final vowel sound.
items.exampleCN: 英语形式丢了末尾的元音。

items.example: Tornare is the ultimate source.
Tornus gives the root image of turning.
items.exampleCN: tornus 给出「转」的核心意象。

items.example: A tourist travels for pleasure.
items.exampleCN: tourist 是为游乐而旅行的人。

items.example: Tourism is the trade of travel.
Touring means travelling on a circuit.
A detour turns away from the road.
Toured is the past tense.
Tours serves both uses.
